articles.title: Indonesia, India strengthen defense ties with BrahMos missile deal
articles.summary: India and Indonesia have significantly strengthened their strategic defense partnership, with Indonesia announcing a major procurement agreement for the Indian-made BrahMos supersonic cruise missile. This high-profile deal underscores India's growing prowess in defense manufacturing and its increasing role as a key security partner in the Indo-Pacific region, enhancing bilateral cooperation and regional stability.

articles.title: The US Navy’s 'Killer' Submarine Is Participating in RIMPAC 2026
articles.summary: Amidst escalating rhetoric from the US administration and Congress labelling China an adversary, the United States continues its tradition of organizing the world's largest naval war practice. The article highlights that 2026 will mark the 30th year of this significant exercise, likely RIMPAC. This ongoing military preparedness underscores the heightened geopolitical tensions and strategic dynamics, particularly in the Indo-Pacific region.

articles.title: President Murmu Unveils Durand Cup Trophies, Flags Off 135th Edition
articles.summary: President Droupadi Murmu unveiled the Durand Cup trophies at Rashtrapati Bhavan, officially flagging off the 135th edition of Asia's oldest football tournament. Organized by the Indian Armed Forces, this prestigious event highlights military engagement and sportsmanship, key values for SSB aspirants. The cup's 1888 inception links national heritage with defence tradition.
